ground_rules: Never type a new sentence into a breed file. Every new fact lives once in src/data/buying-terms.ts or src/data/site.ts and reaches pages through a shared component or an identical codemod line.
Breed pages = the 48 files in src/pages/puppies/*.astro that render <AvailablePuppies>. Exclude index.astro, bernedoodle.astro, labrador.astro.
No invented facts. Copy strings are given in the plan's table (section 3). If a string is not in the plan, do not add it.
No reviews, UEN, guarantee wording changes or founder biography. K-117 is separate.
Each task must end with `npm run build` green and the existing checks (`node scripts/check-content.mjs`, `node scripts/check-links.mjs`) no worse than before the task.
Health, boarding and going-home facts are scoped to puppies at our shop. Never place them inside ImportedPuppies or OverseasPuppies.
